title: Litematica Tool
description: this mod adds a simple item into the game which can be used instead of a stick in litematica.
body:
# Litematica Tool

[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/869218732650688543?label=Discord&style=for-the-badge)](https://discord.com/invite/6VCTUawBz6) [![](https://img.shields.io/badge/My-projects-orange?style=for-the-badge&logo=curseforge)](https://www.curseforge.com/members/finn3253/projects)

**Overview**
------------
Please comment any ideas you may have to improve this mod.

**Forge version** now available for 1.16 (only 1.16 due to litematica forge only being for 1.16)   [forge here](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/litematica-tool/files/3864522 "1.16 version here")

This mod adds another item into the game (the litematica tool) which can be used with litematica instead of the stick.
This mod **requires litematica**: [link](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/litematica)

I made this mod because I found it annoying that every time I had a stick in my hand for example, if I was crafting fences, I wouldn't be able to click on the crafting table. This is a small issue that can get really irritating over time, so in my opinion, this mod is a must-have that I use every time I download litematica.

**HOW TO USE:**
---------------

1. First, you will need to open the litematica menu by pressing "M"
2. Then click on the "configuration menu" button on the "generic" tab,
3. Search "tool" then replace "minecraft:stick" with"litematicatool:the_stick" 
4. Now you can just exit out and your chosen tool for litematica will be the litematica tool.

![tutorial](https://i.imgur.com/1xKddQy.png)

**HOW TO CRAFT:**
-----------------

put a stick in the bottom left and any plank on the top right in a two by two crafting grid.
![enter image description here](https://i.imgur.com/0LXNbUQ.png)
![enter image description here](https://i.imgur.com/rPDYG1o.png)
